shortDescription: Create/remove/modify nodes in SolarWinds Orion NPM

options.name: agent_auto_update
options.description: Enable automatic update of agent versions.

options.name: agent_mode
options.description: Mode of communication between polling engine and agent - either 'active' for agent-initiated communication, or 'passive' for server-initiated.

options.name: agent_port
options.description: Port used to communicate with the agent.

options.name: agent_shared_secret
options.description: Secure string used to communicate with the agent.

options.name: caption
options.description: The SolarWinds 'caption' for the node, if different from the node name.

options.name: credential_names
options.description: List of credential names to use for node discovery

options.name: custom_properties
options.description: A dictionary containing custom properties and their values

options.name: discovery_interface_filters
options.description: List of SolarWinds Orion interface discovery filters

options.name: discovery_polling_engine_name
options.description: Name of polling engine that NPM will use for discovery only (only required if different to polling_engine_name).

options.name: interface_filter_cutoff_max
options.description: Maximum number of interfaces that can be removed from monitoring for a newly discovered device

options.name: interface_filters
options.description: List of regular expressions by which to exclude interfaces from monitoring

options.name: ip_address
options.description: IP Address of the node. One of 'node_id', 'node_name', or 'ip_address' must be provided.

options.name: node_id
options.description: node_id of the node. One of 'node_id', 'node_name', or 'ip_address' must be provided.

options.name: node_name
options.description: FQDN of the node. For adding a node this field is required. For all other states field is optional.

options.name: polling_engine_id
options.description: Id of polling engine to move the node to after successful discovery.

options.name: polling_engine_name
options.description: Name of polling engine to move the node to after successful discovery.

options.name: polling_method
options.description: Polling method to use.

options.name: snmp_allow_64
options.description: Set true if device supports 64-bit counters

options.name: snmp_port
options.description: port that SNMP server listens on

options.name: snmp_version
options.description: SNMPv2c is used by default. SNMPv3 requires use of existing, named SNMPv3 credentials within Orion.

options.name: solarwinds_connection
options.description: SolarWinds connection configuration information.

options.name: state
options.description: The desired state of the node.

options.name: unmanage_from
options.description: The date and time (in ISO 8601 UTC format) to begin the unmanage period. If this is in the past, the node will be unmanaged effective immediately. If not provided, module defaults to now. ex: 2017-02-21T12:00:00Z

options.name: unmanage_until
options.description: The date and time (in ISO 8601 UTC format) to end the unmanage period. You can set this as far in the future as you like. If not provided, module defaults to 24 hours from now. ex: 2017-02-21T12:00:00Z

options.name: volume_filter_cutoff_max
options.description: Maximum number of volumes that can be removed from monitoring for a newly discovered device

options.name: volume_filters
options.description: List of regular expressions by which to exclude volumes from monitoring
